description: I am a 2nd-year Electrical Engineering student specializing in DSP and machine learning. For this challenge, I am building AstroGuard: an edge-computing pipeline using Butterworth filters and PyTorch to detect and attribute astronaut physiological anomalies. I am tackling this hackathon as a strict solo participant to rigorously test my own end-to-end system design skills from scratch. Therefore, I am not looking for team members. Good luck!
